# GT Marketing

> GT Marketing is a Darwin-based Australian marketing agency providing strategy, local SEO, social media marketing, website development, hosting, outreach, automation, analytics and conversion optimisation. The agency is physically based at 130 Smith Street, Darwin City and serves businesses across Darwin City, Casuarina, Palmerston and the wider Northern Territory.

## Core services

- Marketing strategy and positioning
- Search engine optimisation and local SEO
- Social media marketing
- Direct-to-consumer marketing
- Website development and landing pages
- Web hosting
- Email and direct marketing outreach
- Marketing automation
- Analytics, reporting and conversion optimisation

## Local service areas

### Darwin City

GT Marketing is based at 130 Smith Street, Darwin City, Northern Territory 0800. Services for Darwin City businesses include local SEO, website development, growth strategy, social media, lead generation and automation.

### Casuarina

Casuarina is a service area rather than a second GT Marketing office. GT Marketing supports Casuarina and Darwin's northern suburbs with local SEO, websites, content, lead generation and marketing systems.

### Palmerston

Palmerston is a service area rather than a separate GT Marketing office. GT Marketing supports Palmerston businesses with local SEO, website development, social media, lead generation, positioning and marketing automation.

## Industries served

GT Marketing develops marketing systems for tradies, hospitality businesses, NDIS providers, SMEs, agriculture, finance and crypto, real estate, security providers and events.
